tests: GET /api/revenue/channel-manager/all returns 9 channels
Channels: booking_com, expedia, airbnb, hotels_com, agoda, trip_com, google_hotels, trivago, direct
Summary includes total_channels, connected, disconnected, auto_syncing
Direct Website auto-connected on seed
PUT /api/revenue/channel-manager/all/expedia with {connected:true} connects channel
PUT /api/revenue/channel-manager/all/expedia with {connected:false} disconnects channel
Status updates to 'active' or 'disconnected' accordingly
PUT /api/revenue/channel-manager/all/expedia updates rate_rule (same/markup/undercut)
rate_markup_pct stored correctly for markup/undercut rules
POST /api/revenue/channel-manager/all/push-rates pushes rates to connected channels
Returns channels_pushed count, total_rates, results per channel
Creates push log entries in channel_push_logs collection
GET /api/revenue/channel-manager/all/rate-preview?days=7 returns 7 days preview
Each day has date, dow, our_rate, and rate per channel
GET /api/revenue/channel-manager/all/push-logs returns push history
Each log has channel_id, channel_name, rates_pushed, rule, pushed_at
GET /api/revenue/historical-pricing/all returns 730 days data
KPIs: total_data_points, date_range, overall_avg/min/max_rate, year1_avg, year2_avg, yoy_change_pct
monthly_stats: 12 months with avg/min/max/median/p25 rates, avg_occupancy, total_revenue
dow_stats: 7 days (Mon-Sun) with avg/min/max rates
season_stats: 4 seasons (peak, holiday, shoulder, low) with avg/min/max rates, avg_occupancy
min_price_suggestions: 12 months with suggested_min, historical data, reasoning
POST /api/revenue/historical-pricing/all/apply-floors saves price floors
Stores floors in pricing_strategy collection with set_by='historical-analysis'
